entities.name: Léo Errera
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Léo Abram Errera was a Belgian botanist, known for his research in the field of plant physiology. He worked at the Free University of Brussels in 1883 as an associate and in 1890 as a full professor of botany. In addition, he was actively involved in Jewish affairs.
